content: For f-orbital support, the stable mathematical base is the original Slater-Koster two-center/angular transformation approach combined with DFTB+ conventions for real/tesseral orbital ordering. DFTB+ user-list material confirms p ordering differs from px/py/pz and d ordering follows tesseral |-2..2| order; f formulas should therefore be treated as convention-sensitive and validated against DFTB+ or reference fixtures, not hand-entered from an arbitrary table without basis-order checks.
